dedupe_keys.name: debit journalier sur les routes nationales de la reunion

description: Débit journalier sur les routes nationales de La Réunion is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Régional de La Réunion. Débit journalier, pour tous les types de véhicules, comptabilisé sur les routes nationales de La Réunion. Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Transports et déplacements. Its keywords are trafic, vehicule, comptage. The portal shows 705 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
